  • Drive Enterprise API Adoption: You will own the features that turn enterprise interest into deep, durable adoption. Examples include usage insights, cost and consumption controls, and the governance tooling that lets large organizations understand and manage how they use DeepL's APIs

  • Build for Governance & Compliance: You will design the controls enterprise IT and security admins rely on (roles and permissions, projects, data residency, and audit-ability), making DeepL the compliant default for regulated, global organizations

  • Guardianship of Quality & Production Reliability: You will own your services end-to-end, including participation in the API on-call rotation, with a shared goal of taking our public API to four nines of reliability. You will implement strong contract testing, monitoring, and SLOs, preventing breaking changes and security vulnerabilities before they reach our enterprise customers

  • Architect Across the Enterprise Ecosystem: You will work deep within DeepL's existing technical and organizational structures, navigating dependencies across different areas and many stakeholder teams to ship cohesive, reliable enterprise capabilities

  • Enterprise Platform Fluency: You bring hands-on experience with the building blocks of modern enterprise APIs (MCP, CLIs, and OAuth) and know how to wield them to build secure, extensible integrations

  • Cross-Team Leadership: You have a track record of leading projects across multiple teams. You can align with different areas and other stakeholders, manage cross-team contracts and dependencies, and keep complex, interconnected systems coherent

  • Extreme Ownership & Operational Excellence: You own your services end-to-end (production operations, incident response, and on-call) and you're motivated by pushing reliability toward four nines. You write comprehensive tests, learn from incidents, and treat mature SLOs as a core engineering feature

  • AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery so you can focus your energy on high-value architecture and complex problem-solving

title: Risk & Control Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Pleo
description_html:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

We're looking for a Manager to join our Risk & Control team at Pleo. In this role, you'll operate as a key part of our Second Line of Defence, helping to strengthen the risk management framework that underpins everything we do — from our product to our regulatory relationships. You'll work at the intersection of risk expertise and business partnership, offering thoughtful challenges and practical guidance to our First Line teams as we continue to scale. If you're excited by the prospect of shaping how a fast-growing FinTech approaches risk maturity, and are passionate about building robust, pragmatic control environments, this is the role for you.

What you’ll be doing

As a Risk Manager, you will:

  • Strengthen our risk framework – Contribute to the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of Pleo's 2LOD risk management framework, ensuring it remains aligned with regulatory expectations and our evolving business strategy.

  • Review and challenge the First Line – Execute effective oversight activities of the 1LOD, assessing the quality of risk identification, control design, and ongoing management across the business.

  • Be a trusted risk partner – Act as a go-to advisor for business teams and 1LOD stakeholders, providing expert guidance on risk topics, regulatory change, and the broader control environment.

  • Drive insightful risk reporting – Support the development and preparation of clear, data-informed risk reports for senior management and relevant governance committees, surfacing key risk exposures and control gaps.

  • Support regulatory engagement – Contribute to interactions with regulators on risk and control matters, drawing on your subject matter expertise to support well-prepared, credible responses.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Solid financial services experience – Around 5–7 years of experience in a regulated financial services environment (FinTech, banking, payments, or similar), with at least 3 years focused on risk or control management.

  • Credit risk experience - A solid understanding of the assessment and management of credit risk

  • A strong risk and control foundation – A professional background rooted in risk management and control functions, with hands-on experience in execution and assurance activities. Experience spanning both 1LOD and 2LOD is a real plus.

  • The ability to influence – A proven track record of engaging and influencing stakeholders on complex or sensitive risk topics, with the confidence to challenge constructively and the credibility to be heard.

  • Clear, collaborative communication – The ability to translate risk concepts into practical, accessible language for a range of audiences, from technical teams to senior leadership.

  • A pragmatic, solutions-oriented mindset – A passion for finding workable answers to real risk challenges, rather than defaulting to theoretical frameworks alone.

Highly desirable: Experience at both a FinTech and a traditional banking or payments institution is something we'd particularly welcome. And while 5–7 years is our general expectation, exceptional candidates with around 4 years of deeply relevant experience are encouraged to apply.

This role is not suited to candidates whose background is primarily in professional services/consultancy, internal audit, or compliance without substantial risk and control experience.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You'll report directly to our Head of Risk and Control and work closely with First Line teams across the business. Our Risk & Control function is collaborative by design — you'll have regular exposure to senior stakeholders and the opportunity to partner with teams spanning Product, Operations, Finance, and Compliance to drive a culture of sound risk management across Pleo.


How you’ll develop in this role
In your first 12 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Get under the skin of Pleo's risk landscape and take ownership of key 2LOD review and challenge activities across priority business areas.

  • Play an active role in evolving our risk framework as the company continues to scale — contributing your expertise to initiatives that will shape how we manage risk for years to come.

  • Build strong relationships across the business, establishing yourself as a credible and trusted voice on risk matters.

We're committed to helping you grow here — whether that means deepening your technical expertise, expanding your regulatory knowledge, or stepping into broader leadership responsibilities as the team develops.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25+ days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

In this role, you'll help grow and expand our existing customer base and be part of the Customer Growth & Expansion team as we scale. If you're excited about strategic account management, obsessed with customer outcomes, know how to unlock expansion across complex organisation, you love nurturing relationships, identifying growth levers, proving ROI, and are passionate about spend management, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Senior Sales Manager, Account Management and work closely with teams in Customer Success, Deal Desk, Pricing and Enablement. Our team of 16 is highly collaborative and dedicated to delivering value and growing our existing customer base. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Sales, Support, Product and Marketing to ensure success.

What you’ll be doing

As an Account Manager, you will:

  • Identify and close opportunities within your book of business to grow accounts through upsells, new entities, teams, and product capabilities aligned to evolving customer needs.

  • Build deep relationships with key stakeholders to understand their strategic initiatives, and uncover whitespace opportunities.

  • Use MEDDICC (or similar) to rigorously qualify upsell and cross-sell opportunities to ensure forecast accuracy and deal velocity.

  • Showcase new product features, integrations, and advanced workflows that drive stronger adoption and platform value for upsells.

  • Create custom proposals and business cases that quantify value, align with commercial goals, and support customer budgeting cycles.

  • Work across senior finance, procurement, and operations stakeholders to land multi-threaded expansions.

  • Lead commercial conversations ensuring terms reflect the value Pleo delivers.

  • Use customer success stories, usage data, and ROI metrics to proactively pitch new functionality and deepen platform adoption.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • A solid understanding of value-based selling and consultative approach

  • Skilled in contract negotiations and building business cases linking features to value

  • Strong understanding of qualification methodologies (e.g., MEDDICC)

  • A passion for solving problems with a solution-oriented approach

  • Data-driven, goal-oriented, and accurate forecasting ability

  • Strong commercial acumen and ability to navigate senior stakeholders

  • A background in SaaS Account Management or Customer Growth with a proven track record of expansion revenue and high net revenue retention

  • Complete fluency in English

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You are naturally curious and driven to map out complex organisations, identifying white space where Pleo can solve a genuine business need.

  • You get a rush from closing upsells by proving ROI and prefer driving proactive growth over simply waiting for a renewal.

  • You use frameworks like MEDDICC to keep deals on track and can easily show a CFO how tech features translate into financial value.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You view Account Management solely as responding to support tickets or handling administrative renewals rather than proactively hunting for expansion opportunities and driving revenue.

  • You require a rigid, unchanging playbook to succeed. We are scaling fast, which means processes evolve and you’ll need to be comfortable building the plane while flying it.

  • You prefer simple, single-point-of-contact relationships. This role requires multi-threading across Finance, IT, and Procurement in mid-market organizations.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 to 12 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead targeted account whitespace analysis to drive impact in your assigned market segment.

  • Collaborate with Product and Marketing to improve feedback loops that influence our mid-market product roadmap.

  • Grow your skills in complex commercial negotiation and value engineering, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale

The location


Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience

  3. Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

  4. Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

title: Regional Sales Director, Strategic Enterprise - UK
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Samsara
description_html:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's UK Enterprise business is one of our fastest-growing segments globally. We've scaled rapidly over the past several years — consistently outpacing the broader business — and we're now at an inflection point where we need to pair that momentum with operational rigour to sustain growth at scale. 

This Regional Sales Director role is central to that next chapter. You'll lead a team of six Senior Enterprise Account Executives and Client Directors selling into some of the UK's largest and most complex organisations, spanning transportation, logistics, infrastructure, utilities, and field services. 

The team is performing — but we want to turn strong results into a repeatable, scalable engine. That means bringing structure, coaching discipline, and a proven enterprise playbook without losing the pace and builder energy that got us here.

In this role, you will: 

  • Own the performance, development, and day-to-day leadership of a team of Senior Enterprise AEs, driving net new logo acquisition and expansion across a defined set of strategic UK accounts
  • Coach your team through complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles where average contract values regularly reach seven figures over multi-year terms
  • Build and run a structured operating rhythm - pipeline reviews, deal inspection, forecasting discipline - while getting close enough to the detail to add value at the deal level
  • Develop your reps' ability to access economic buyers, build multi-threaded relationships, and position Samsara's expanding product portfolio against a customer's most critical business priorities
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large UK enterprises - this isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles - cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping - that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across the UK's largest accounts
  • Partner closely with the AVP of Strategic and Enterprise Sales UK, your peer RSDs, and cross-functional teams including Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Marketing to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Proven experience as a frontline or second-line sales leader in B2B enterprise technology, with direct responsibility for team quota attainment
  • Track record of coaching Account Executives through complex, multi-quarter sales cycles with average deal sizes of £250K+ ACV, but with experience of seven figure ACV deals 
  • Experience selling into large, multi-stakeholder organisations where procurement, legal, and multiple business units are involved in the buying decision
  • Demonstrated ability to build and enforce a structured sales operating cadence — pipeline generation, deal qualification, forecasting accuracy, and stage progression
  • Strong commercial instinct for multi-product or platform selling, where the value proposition spans multiple use cases and buyer personas

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company that was scaling its enterprise go-to-market in the UK or EMEA — ideally where you helped build or refine the playbook rather than inheriting an established one
  • A coaching-first leadership style with a track record of developing AEs from good to exceptional, not just managing top performers
  • Experience managing forecast accuracy as a discipline, not just an output — particularly in an environment where leadership investment decisions depend on the reliability of your calls
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you're expected to build process while delivering results
  • A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity — you can set a multi-year account strategy and also jump into a deal review and tell a rep exactly where their qualification is weak

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

description_html:
Meaningful jobs. Great work. Better world. 

Vebego ist ein führendes Facility-Service-Unternehmen in Europa – mit über 40.000 Kolleg*innen, die täglich Orte gestalten, an denen Menschen gerne arbeiten, leben und sich wohlfühlen. 

Mit unserem deutschen Headquarter in Wuppertal und über 50 Standorten bieten wir Services, die Unternehmen und Menschen voranbringen – darunter Gebäudereinigung, Sicherheitsdienste, Industriereinigung, Grünpflege und Technisches Gebäudemanagement. title: AI Strategy & Automation Lead (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at benuta GmbH
description_html:
E-Commerce nicht nur am Laufen halten, sondern den Arbeitsalltag durch Generative AI und smarte Automatisierung radikal vereinfachen? Bei benuta bist du der strategische Kopf, der manuelle Routineaufgaben eliminiert und ungenutzte Effizienzpotenziale in echten Business Impact verwandelt. Wir ruhen uns nicht auf unserem Erfolg als europäischer Marktführer aus – KI ist bei uns bereits in ersten Bereichen gelebte Realität. Jetzt wollen wir Komplexität systematisch über alle Abteilungen hinweg abbauen. In dieser Single-Person-Funktion hast du die volle Ownership, agierst ohne bürokratische Schleifen und treibst den KI-Einsatz direkt mit dem C-Level voran. Wenn du Lust hast, echte Pionierarbeit zu leisten und die Arbeit für das gesamte Team spürbar leichter zu machen, dann ist das hier deine nächste Challenge!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Use Cases identifizieren und priorisieren: Du baust ein Portfolio an AI- und Automation-Use-Cases auf, priorisierst nach Business Impact und Umsetzbarkeit und stimmst die Roadmap mit COO und CEO ab.

  • Eigenständiges Arbeiten: Du arbeitest aktiv mit Mitarbeitenden aus Produktentwicklung, Design, Category Management, Einkauf, Vertrieb, Customer Service, Logistik und Geschäftsführung. Du verstehst ihre Abläufe und erkennst, wo AI Zeit spart, Qualität verbessert oder neue Möglichkeiten schafft.

  • Strategische Ziele setzen und tracken: Du formulierst gemeinsam mit C-Level klare KPI-Ziele je Bereich und steuerst die Umsetzung über Quartalsziele.

  • Lösungen mit den richtigen AI-Tools bauen: Du arbeitest mit den führenden AI-Plattformen (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini) sowie Workflow- und Automation-Tools (n8n, Make, Zapier oder vergleichbar). Wo Plattform-Integration nötig ist, definierst du die Anforderungen und arbeitest eng mit dem Head of Platform Engineering zusammen.

  • Wissenstransfer und Befähigung: Du schulst Mitarbeitende im sicheren und produktiven Umgang mit AI-Tools, baust ein internes AI-Champion-Netzwerk auf und sorgst dafür, dass die Fachbereiche selbstständig damit arbeiten können.

  • Governance und Datenschutz: Du definierst die internen Spielregeln für den Einsatz von AI – Datenklassifizierung, DSGVO-Konformität, IP-Schutz – in enger Abstimmung mit IT und Geschäftsführung.

Beispiele für Anwendungsfelder bei benuta:

  • Design und Produktentwicklung: AI-generierte Teppichdesigns und Mustervarianten, die in echte Produkte übergehen – analog zur Inszenierungs-Bildwelt, die wir heute schon vollständig AI-gestützt produzieren.

  • Customer Service: Klassifizierung und Pre-Drafting von Tickets, Reduktion manueller Standardantworten, schnellere Reaktionszeiten.

  • Category und Einkauf: Sortimentsanalysen, Wettbewerbsbeobachtung, AI-gestützte Lieferanten- und Vertragsprüfung.

  • Internes Wissen und Mitarbeiterproduktivität: AI-Wissensagent für alle Mitarbeitenden auf Basis interner Dokumente, Prozesse und Verträge; AI-gestützte Standard- automatisierungen über alle Abteilungen hinweg.


Dein Profil

  • Fundierte KI- & Praxis-Expertise: Du bringst 5 bis 8 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung mit, davon mindestens 2 bis 3 Jahre in der praktischen, nachweisbar produktiven Umsetzung von Generative AI- und LLM-basierten Lösungen im Unternehmenskontext.

  • Digitalisierung, Updates, Fortbildungen: Maßgebliche (Mit-)Gestaltung unserer Digitalisierungsprozesse, Schnittstellen zu unserem EDV-Team, individuelle Fortbildungen u. v. m. – wir bringen dich weiter!

  • Team-Events, Sportangebote, Betriebsausflüge, Weihnachtsfeier, Karnevalsfeier, Lauf- und Fitness-Termine, Urban Sports und EGYM Wellpass, Firmenläufe u. v. m. – wir bei der VRT sind von Natur aus sehr gesellig!


  • Voraussetzungen: Ausbildung im Steuerwesen (z. B. Steuerfachangestellte, Steuerfachwirt (m/w/d)) plus erweiterte Kenntnisse in DATEV, eventuell erste Kenntnisse in der DATEV-Administration

  • Optimal: Weiterbildung, z. B. Fachassistent/-in Digitalisierung und IT-Prozesse (FAIT), zertifizierter Fibutroniker oder DATEV Kanzlei-Organisationsbeauftragter (m/w/d)

  • Sehr wichtig: zielorientierte Vorgehensweise, strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Bereitschaft zum tageweisen Einsatz an den VRT-Standorten in Köln/Bonn, Rhein-Sieg-Kreis oder Kreis Euskirchen sowie verständliche Kommunikation und Präsentation gegenüber unterschiedlichen Zielgruppen


Bewirb dich jetzt bei der VRT!
Mit rund 290 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern und 20 Partnern an unseren neun Standorten (Bad Honnef, Bonn, Euskirchen, Füssen, Gemünd, Köln, Meckenheim, Rheinbach, Siegburg) arbeiten wir jeden Tag aufs Neue an interessanten Aufgabenstellungen für kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen, größere Unternehmen (MDax) sowie Existenzgründer und Privatpersonen in den Bereichen Steuerberatung, Rechtsberatung und Wirtschaftsprüfung.

description_html:
Als Verkaufstalent in unserer Boutique in Düsseldorf Airport (24–32 Stunden) bist du das Gesicht von My Jewellery. Du begrüßt Kund/-innen mit viel Begeisterung, gibst persönliche Styling-Tipps und sorgst dafür, dass jede Person die Boutique mit einem Lächeln verlässt. Deine Aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt und berätst Kund/-innen und sorgst für persönlichen Service

  • Du bist flexibel und kannst zwischen 24 und 32 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten

  • Du arbeitest proaktiv und bringst gerne eigene Initiative ein

  • Du wohnst in oder in der Nähe von Düsseldorf

Über My Jewellery

My Jewellery wurde 2011 gegründet und zählt heute zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Marken- und E-Commerce Unternehmen der Niederlande, mit internationalem Wachstum. Wir entwickeln Kollektionen und Kampagnen, die das Leben unserer Community jeden Tag ein kleines bisschen schöner machen. Gemeinsam mit über 1.000 Kolleg/-innen bauen wir täglich an einer Marke voller Kreativität, Ambition und Persönlichkeit.

Unsere Kultur? Persönlich, engagiert und lebendig. Bei uns kannst du ganz du selbst sein und bekommst den Raum, dich weiterzuentwickeln, zu lernen und wirklich etwas zu bewegen. Trotz unseres starken internationalen Wachstums bleiben die Kommunikationswege kurz, die Strukturen flach und der Teamspirit stark. Gemeinsam wollen wir jeden Tag einen Unterschied machen.

title: Senior Berater*in und Programm-Manager*in Kooperationen & Collective Impact (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Phineo
description_html:
Dein neuer Job

Unsere Vision ist eine offene, nachhaltige und friedliche Gesellschaft, in der Gutes tun mit Wirkung das gemeinsame Handeln leitet. Um dazu unseren Beitrag zu leisten, haben wir PHINEO als gemeinnützige Plattform für strategisches gesellschaftliches Engagement aufgebaut.

Gesellschaftliche Herausforderungen lassen sich heute nur gemeinsam lösen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Unternehmen, Stiftungen, Sozialunternehmen, öffentlichen Institutionen und zivilgesellschaftlichen Organisationen daran, sektorübergreifende Zusammenarbeit zu stärken und mehr Wirkung zu erzielen. Für unser Team in Berlin suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die Beratungs-, Netzwerk- und Gestaltungskompetenz miteinander verbindet, als Senior Berater*in und Programm-Manager*in Kooperationen & Collective Impact (m/w/d).


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du bringst Akteur*innen aus Wirtschaft, Zivilgesellschaft, Philanthropie und öffentlichem Sektor gezielt zusammen, um Kooperationen mit gesellschaftlichem Impact anzuregen. Dafür entwickelst du neue Formen der sektorübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit. Parallel gestaltest und moderierst du etablierte Dialogformate im analogen und digitalen Raum.
  • Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle bei IMPACT COLLECTIVES, unserem neuen Angebot, das Impact Startups mit Unternehmen, Investor*innen und weiteren Enablern aus Wissenschaft, Verwaltung und Zivilgesellschaft themenspezifisch verbinden wird und damit strukturellen Wandel entlang der großen gesellschaftlichen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit vorantreibt.
  • Du leitest unsere Corporate Citizenship Arbeitsgruppe, entwickelst sie strategisch weiter, gewinnst neue Unternehmen für die Mitwirkung. Du gestaltest gemeinsam mit Vertreter*innen aus Wirtschaft, Zivilgesellschaft und öffentlicher Hand Impulse für eine wirksame gesellschaftliche Verantwortung von Unternehmen.
  • Du konzipierst, akquirierst und verantwortest Beratungs- und Kooperationsprojekte. Beispielsweise berätst du Startups, die wissen möchten, wie sie mehr Impact erzielen oder Investor*innen finden können, oder begleitest Kooperationen zwischen Unternehmen und Nonprofits prozessual wie inhaltlich.
  • Du steuerst komplexe Projekte eigenverantwortlich von der Konzeption über das Partnermanagement bis zur Umsetzung und Auswertung. Handlungsleitend sind für dich der angestrebte gesellschaftliche Mehrwert und eine wirtschaftliche Umsetzung.
Bei der Arbeit bist du selbstverständlich nicht auf dich allein gestellt. Vielmehr bist du Teil eines engagierten Teams, das verschiedene Kompetenzen und Perspektiven vereint.


Das bringst Du mit

  • Du setzt dich mit Leidenschaft für gesellschaftliche Transformation, nachhaltiges Wirtschaften und die Zusammenarbeit von Akteur*innen aus unterschiedlichen gesellschaftlichen Bereichen ein.
  • Du bringst die Energie, Überzeugungskraft und Empathie mit, die es braucht, um Vertrauen aufzubauen und Menschen für gemeinsame Ziele zu gewinnen. Auch skeptische Akteur*innen kannst du inspirieren und aktivieren.
  • Du bringst Beratungserfahrung mit, idealerweise mit Startups, Investor*innen oder Unternehmen zu Fragen rund um Strategie oder Organisationentwicklung. Daher kannst du Beratungsprozesse konzipieren, eigenständig durchführen und zu belastbaren Ergebnissen führen.
  • Du hast in der Vergangenheit bereits Netzwerke aufgebaut oder intensiv betreut, idealerweise mit Beteiligung von Akteuren aus der Wirtschaft und aus dem Startup-Bereich. Du kannst relevante Akteure zeitnah identifizieren und sie mit unseren Zielgruppen vernetzen. Du besitzt Erfahrungen mit Multi-Stakeholder-Prozessen oder Collective-Impact-Ansätzen. Du bewegst dich sicher im Umgang mit Entscheider*innen auf Konzern- beziehungsweise Leitungsebene.
  • Du hast nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Gewinnung von Partner*innen, Kund*innen oder Förder*innen sowie in der eigenverantwortlichen Leitung komplexer Projekte.


Deine Vorteile bei uns

Purpose

  • Ein sinnstiftender Job mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Die Möglichkeit, an relevanten gesellschaftlichen Themen wie nachhaltige Wirtschaft, Stärkung von Demokratie und Klimaschutz mitzuarbeiten.
  • Eine Organisation, die danach strebt, eine Vielfalt an Identitäten, Erfahrungshintergründen und Perspektiven zusammenzubringen.
  • Ein großes Netzwerk an Kontakten aus Politik, Wirtschaft und Zivilgesellschaft.

Konditionen und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • 39 Stunden pro Woche in Vollzeit, Teilzeit bis zu 80% möglich.
  • Die Befristung des Arbeitsvertrages (2 Jahre) ist ein Punkt, an dem wir noch einmal gemeinsam reflektieren und eine bewusste Entscheidung treffen – hoffentlich füreinander. Sie ist ein Standard in all unseren neuen Arbeitsverhältnissen, um Achtsamkeit und Bewusstsein auf beiden Seiten der Beziehung zu stärken.

title: Working Student – Content and Data Management (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Ctrl Qs
description_html:
Description

We are looking for a Berlin-based detail-oriented Working Student (all genders) to support our Content Operations team in maintaining and managing digital product content.

In this role, you will help ensure that digital assets and product data are accurately maintained across our systems, enabling smooth campaign launches and consistent product information across markets. You will work with digital experience platforms such as CMS (Content Management Systems) and other content tools, contributing to keeping product and marketing content structured, reliable, and scalable. 

Your work plays a key role in maintaining high data quality and supporting efficient content operations.


What you´ll do

In this role, you will support operational content processes and ensure high-quality product data across systems.

Operational execution

  • Support content maintenance activities across digital platforms such as CMS, PIM, DAM, based on defined briefs
  • Clean, archive, and reorganize assets according to guidelines provided
  • Link assets correctly within the PIM environment after DAM upload
  • Support additional operational content tasks such as migrations, content updates, testing, or data validation activities, bulk updates, and checking that content is published and displayed as per the briefs.


Quality & compliance

  • Follow documented processes and governance rules carefully
  • Maintain tracking documentation (e.g. Excel trackers for updates and changes)
  • Perform peer quality checks before delivering tasks
  • Identify and flag missing information or inconsistencies in briefs

Coordination & reporting

  • Provide updates on task progress
  • Escalate blockers early to help maintain timelines
  • Document recurring issues to support process improvements

 

What success looks like in this role

  • Deliver accurate uploads and content or product data updates
  • Maintain correct linking between DAM and PIM systems with zero critical errors
  • Complete tasks within agreed service-level timelines (SLA)
  • Handle larger batches of tasks reliably without loss of quality
  • Reduce rework through thorough quality checks
  • Proactively identify recurring data inconsistencies or improvement opportunities


What you can offer

  • Must be enrolled as a student in a German university for at least another year.
  • Strong attention to detail, process orientation, and ownership of accurate, high-quality data
  • Basic Excel and structured data skills, with the ability to understand relationships, dependencies, and troubleshoot issues
  • Proactive communication when questions, blockers, or inconsistencies occur
  • Good technical affinity with interest in digital systems, content tools, and AI-supported ways of working
  • Comfortable reading documentation and applying defined guidelines carefully
  • Ability to work independently after onboarding while knowing when to ask for support
  • Above all, curiosity and genuine interest in learning how we work

Nice to have

  • Experience with CMS Tridion, PIM, DAM, or similar systems
  • Experience working with custom digital interfaces or content tools


What we offer

  • Work-Life Wellbeing. At ctrl QS, we value your well-being and encourage our team members to maintain a healthy balance between work and personal. We understand that agency life can be highly dynamic and fast-paced, therefore we utilize a time-tracking tool to ensure you receive appropriate compensation through time off for any extra hours worked. Our company offers a flexible working environment, providing options for both full-time and part-time positions. Additionally, you'll enjoy 28 days of vacation every year, ensuring you have the time to recharge and explore your passions outside of work.
  • Vibrant Office in Central Berlin. Located in the digital heart of central Berlin, our bright office space fosters professional and personal interactions.
  • Continuous Learning and Career Growth. We're dedicated to providing a unique learning environment where you can pursue your career goals. We help you find your place at ctrl QS, with a focus on your development goals. You’ll find fluid career paths with opportunities to specialize or grow laterally. Also, our internal Academy offers a wealth of learning opportunities.
  • Diverse and Supportive Team. Join our team of 190 passionate, committed, and fun people from more than 40 nations. We celebrate diversity and welcome everyone to bring their unique perspectives, challenge conventions, and ignite creativity. Together, we form a multicultural and fun-loving team that thrives on collaboration.
  • People-First Culture. At ctrl QS, we prioritize our people above all else. We strive to cultivate a healthy company culture where everyone feels safe and satisfied. Engage in regular team-building activities, fun sport and health initiatives, monthly team lunches, weekly company breakfasts, and regular team events are all part of the routine. And of course, our famous summer and Christmas parties are not to be missed!

salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Ba Tax Gmbh
description_html:
Das erwartet dich

Zahlen sind Deine Sprache, DATEV Dein Zuhause und Prozesse dürfen bei Dir gerne auch mal neu gedacht werden? Dann suchen wir genau Dich.

Bei ba tax denken wir Kanzleiarbeit anders: digital, unkompliziert und im Team auf Augenhöhe. Die DATEV-Administration liegt bei uns in den Händen eines eingespielten 3er-Teams. Durch die anstehende Cloud-Migration von DATEV und eine stetig wachsende Mandantschaft nehmen Themen und Nachfragen spürbar zu – genug Substanz für eine Rolle mit echter Verantwortung und viel Raum zum Mitgestalten.


Deine Vorteile

  • 50 % Homeoffice: Arbeite flexibel – so, wie es zu deinem Leben passt

  • Echte Wertschätzung: Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe, offenes Miteinander

  • Digital & effizient: Moderne Tools, papierloses Arbeiten, klare Prozesse

  • Zentrale Lage: Kurze Wege, gute Anbindung, schöner Arbeitsplatz

  • Mehr Freizeit: 30 Urlaubstage + 6 zusätzliche freie Tage

  • Mobilität inklusive: Deutschlandticket übernehmen wir komplett

  • Finanzielle Extras: Nettolohnoptimierung & Zuschuss zur Altersvorsorge

  • Gesund & modern: Ergonomische Arbeitsplätze & Team-Events mit Spaßfaktor


Deine Aufgaben

  • Erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Mandanten bei allen Fragen rund um DATEV – von der Rechteverwaltung bis zur Fehlerbehebung im Alltag

Du bringst mit

  • Eine Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellte:r mit ausgeprägtem IT-Interesse – oder eine IT-nahe Ausbildung (z. B. Fachinformatiker:in, IT-Systemkaufmann/-frau) mit Erfahrung in DATEV-Umgebungen, idealerweise im Kanzleiumfeld
  • Umfangreiche Kenntnisse in DATEV Kanzlei-Rechnungswesen, Unternehmen online oder vergleichbaren DATEV-Anwendungen
  • Eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise – auch wenn mehrere Anfragen gleichzeitig reinkommen
  • Klare, geduldige Kommunikation, auch wenn eine Mandantenanfrage zum dritten Mal das gleiche Problem beschreibt
  • Idealerweise hast Du die Weiterbildung zum/zur FAIT (Fachassistent IT) schon gemacht – oder Lust, Dich bei uns dahin zu entwickeln
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gute Englischkenntnisse

description_html:
Hinweis:

Gerne möchten wir den Praktikumsplatz kurzfristig besetzen. Das Praktikum ist für sechs Monate vorgesehen.


Deine Rolle bei Acture

  • Du bist für die Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Workshops, rund um Themen wie Ergonomie im Arbeitsalltag oder Rückengesundheit verantwortlich und hast dabei direkten Kundenkontakt
  • Reisebereitschaft ist uns wichtig – denn viele Projekte finden direkt beim Kunden statt und sind daher mit kurzen Geschäftsreisen verbunden
  • Dich interessieren verschiedene Trainingsangebote? - Gestalte mit uns Videos und Livestreams 
  • Keine Woche ist wie die andere – aber genau das macht dein Praktikum bei Acture Germany so spannend, vielseitig und lehrreich


Dein Profil

  • Du verfügst über einen Hochschulabschluss (mind. Bachelor) im Bereich Sportwissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Physiotherapie
  • Du hast Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office, insb. Outlook, Powerpoint, Excel und Word
  • Du bist kommunikativ, offen und fühlst dich bei Präsentationen und Workshops wohl
  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, hast eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und bist motiviert, deinen großen Gestaltungsspielraum zu nutzen
  • Du bist ein Teamplayer, begeistert andere mit deinen Ideen und bist zuverlässig in der Zusammenarbeit
  • Du hast einen Führerschein Klasse B und fühlst dich wohl damit in der Stadt zu fahren und nimmst auch mal eine längere Reise auf dich
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) und fließend Englisch (B2)
Nice to Have
  • Idealerweise hast du eine Weiterbildung im Bereich Bewegungs- oder Entspannungstechniken wie z.B. Fitnesstrainer:in B Lizenz, Yogalehrer:in uvm. 
  • Du hast bereits erste praktische Kenntnisse in einem Unternehmen sammeln können – als Praktikant*in oder Werkstudent*in
  • Du hast schon einmal Workshops vor einer Gruppe angeleitet


Warum wir?

Als Teil des Acture Teams in Deutschland bist du von aufgeschlossenen, smarten Menschen umgeben, die mit Leidenschaft an unserer gemeinsamen Mission arbeiten. Dabei legen wir Wert auf ein gesundes Umfeld zum Arbeiten und Leben, einschließlich flexibler Arbeitszeiten und Home Office.

Neben einer fairen Vergütung profitierst du von zusätzlichen Benefits: 

  • Ein Deutschlandticket als Firmenticket mit einem jährlichen Gegenwert von rund 720 €
  • Eine Firmenfitness-Mitgliedschaft über Urban Sports Club oder Wellpass mit einem jährlichen Mehrwert von rund 600 €
Damit investieren wir gezielt und messbar in deine Mobilität, Gesundheit und fachliche Weiterentwicklung.


Wie wir arbeiten

Offene Kommunikation und gegenseitige Unterstützung sind die Säulen unserer Zusammenarbeit. Wir helfen einander und fordern uns gegenseitig heraus, um unsere Ziele gemeinsam zu erreichen und uns täglich zu verbessern.
Dabei übernehmen wir volle Verantwortung für unsere eigenen Aufgaben und Projekte, stellen uns Herausforderungen mit offenen Armen und lösen Probleme proaktiv. Unser tägliches Handeln ist geprägt von Integrität und Respekt. Wir möchten das Leben unserer Mitmenschen positiv beeinflussen und sind uns unserer sozialen Verantwortung bewusst. Wir begrüßen Diversity nicht nur, sondern suchen sie gezielt.

Das Kölner Institut für Managementberatung (KI.M) ist Teil von Acture Germany. Seit vielen Jahren begleiten wir Unternehmen bei Themen rund um Eignungsdiagnostik, Leadership Development sowie Personal- und Organisationsentwicklung. Dabei verbinden wir fachliche Exzellenz mit hoher Kundenorientierung und dem persönlichen Engagement unserer Berater:innen, Trainer:innen und Coaches.

Gleichzeitig beginnt für das KI.M die nächste Wachstumsphase: Neben unserem erfolgreichen Beratungsgeschäft möchten wir neue Potenziale erschließen, unser Geschäftsmodell gezielt weiterentwickeln, digitale und hybride Angebote ausbauen und die Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der Acture Gruppe weiter stärken. 

Für diese Aufgabe suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende Führungspersönlichkeit als Managing Director (m/w/d).

Dabei leitest du nicht einfach ein bestehendes Unternehmen: Du gestaltest die Zukunft des KI.M aktiv mit und verbindest Leadership, Product- und Business Development.


Deine Rolle bei Acture

  • Du stärkst die Positionierung des KI.M innerhalb der Acture Gruppe sowie am Markt und fungierst als wichtiges Bindeglied zwischen dem KI.M und den Teams von Acture Germany.

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Ausbau von Kundenbeziehungen, der Erschließung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und der Weiterentwicklung von Produkten und Geschäftsfeldern.
  • Du verfügst über exzellente Kommunikations- und Storytelling-Fähigkeiten sowie ein souveränes Auftreten und kannst dich entsprechend auf unterschiedliche Zielgruppen und Stakeholder einstellen. Dadurch bist du in der Lage, andere für deine Ideen und Vorstellungen zu gewinnen und zu begeistern.
  • Du verfügst über Erfahrung oder ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für digitale Geschäftsmodelle, hybride Leistungsangebote und skalierbare Dienstleistungen.
  • Du bist souverän im Umgang mit dynamischen, wachstumsstarken Umfeldern, verfügst über eine hohe Eigenmotivation und eine ausgeprägte Organisationsfähigkeit.
  • Zudem bist du bereit, Termine und Projekte nicht nur online, sondern auch vor Ort wahrzunehmen und bringst die entsprechende Reisebereitschaft mit.
  • Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Diplom oder Master) in BWL, VWL, Psychologie oder vergleichbar.

title: AI Consultant (all genders) - Hybrid, Berlin/Frankfurt
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Dida
description_html:
Your mission

Bringing ML research into application

dida builds custom machine learning software for industrial and enterprise clients, among them Siemens, Deutsche Bahn, idealo, klöckner.i and Enpal, and has received the Microsoft “AI for Earth Award” for innovative environmental projects, among other recognitions. Our team combines scientific excellence with real business requirements.

Many of our projects start with a concept or evaluation workshop: together with the decision makers we assess use cases and the data situation and turn vague ideas into a concrete project roadmap. We are currently building this workshop format into a consulting offering of its own, and we are looking for reinforcement.

Your role: strategic and technical consulting

As an AI Consultant you are the bridge between our ML scientists and the business units of our clients. You work in tandem with the Account Management and Business Development team and take the technical lead in workshops and pre-sales meetings.

In this position you are the face of dida for specific industries: you follow no rigid process, but develop innovative solutions together with our engineers and our clients.

Your tasks

  • Prepare and run workshops: You prepare client workshops and run them together with the team. Your part is the technical depth: assessing use cases, reviewing the data situation, judging feasibility and translating complex ML concepts into clear business cases.
  • Turn results into roadmaps: You translate workshop results into technical roadmaps and work with our ML teams on effort estimates and proposal content.
  • Work hands-on: You look at client data yourself and build clickable prototypes and small demos that make workshop results tangible right away.
  • Support business development: You bring in technical expertise, for example in discovery calls or on feasibility questions. Commercial responsibility for accounts, offers, pricing and negotiations stays with the sales team.
  • Develop our standards: You extend our workshop frameworks and templates that we reuse with every new client.


Your Profile

  • Education: A strong degree in a quantitative field, for example data science, computer science, mathematics, physics or engineering.
  • Consulting experience: Ideally 2 to 5 years. Big firm or boutique matters less than having worked on projects directly at the client. Exposure to several industries is a plus.
  • Data science and coding: You understand how ML models work and know your way around databases. Practical data science experience and solid coding skills, above all in Python, are a plus.
  • Hands-on mentality: You try things out directly and enjoy building a first prototype quickly.
  • Presence with clients: You enjoy standing in front of clients, moderate discussions confidently and explain technical content in a way that both the business side and IT understand.
  • Languages: Business-fluent German for the DACH market and fluent English for our internal communication.
  • Teamwork: You like working closely with others. Sharing knowledge and giving direct feedback are part of the job for you.

Even if you do not tick every box: we look forward to your application.


Why us?

  • Building something: You help build a young consulting offering from the start and see the effect of your work directly at the client.
  • Team: Close to 40 people from different disciplines with a strong mathematics and physics background, many of them with a PhD.
  • Flexibility: Flexible hours and hybrid work, full-time or part-time.
  • Office: A nice office with good coffee in Berlin-Kreuzberg near Moritzplatz, and in the future in Frankfurt.
  • Short paths: Direct collaboration with the management team.
  • Location: Berlin. Frankfurt am Main is possible by arrangement, many of our clients are based in southern and south-western Germany.


What we need from you?

Please include with your application:

  • CV (required)
  • Degree certificates (required)
  • Transcripts of records, if available
  • Project or code samples (optional)

title: Werkstudent*in Review Management & Feedbackanalyse (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Aok Connect
description_html:
Bewerbungsfrist

Donnerstag, 01. Oktober 2026


So gestaltest du mit

Wir suchen Verstärkung für unser Team im Review Management: Du beantwortest Rezensionen, wertest Nutzer*innenfeedback aus und machst wiederkehrende Anliegen für unser Team sichtbar.

  • Du sichtest regelmäßig Rezensionen und Nutzer*innenfeedback zu unseren digitalen Angeboten, insbesondere zu unseren Apps, kategorisierst sie nachvollziehbar nach Themen, Anliegen und Stimmungslage und erkennst dabei zentrale Muster, wiederkehrende Hinweise und akute Auffälligkeiten.
  • Du formulierst, prüfst und finalisierst Antworten auf Rezensionen – wertschätzend, verständlich, adressatengerecht und im Rahmen abgestimmter Kommunikationsleitlinien.
  • Du bereitest zentrale Erkenntnisse aus der Auswertung regelmäßig in kurzen Übersichten, Tabellen oder Reports auf und dokumentierst sie so, dass sie für Kommunikation, Support und Produktentwicklung nutzbar werden.
  • Mit wachsender Erfahrung unterstützt du dabei, Antwortbausteine, Kategorien, Auswertungslogiken und Arbeitsabläufe im Review Management weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du bringst Ideen ein, wie digitale Werkzeuge und KI sinnvoll bei Kategorisierung, Antwortentwürfen, Zusammenfassungen und Reporting unterstützen können und prüfst Ergebnisse sorgfältig auf Qualität und Verständlichkeit.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du bist eingeschriebene*r Student*in an einer Hochschule oder Fachhochschule, idealerweise in den Fachrichtungen Kommunikationswissenschaft, Medien-, Sozial- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Psychologie, Digital Health oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang, und hast mindestens das dritte Semester erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
  • Du schreibst sehr sicher und stilsicher auf Deutsch und hast ein sehr gutes Gespür für Sprache, Tonalität und adressatengerechte Kommunikation.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, sorgfältig und eigenständig und verbindest kommunikative Stärke mit analytischem Denken – du kannst Rückmeldungen nicht nur beantworten, sondern auch auswerten, einordnen und verständlich zusammenfassen. 
  • Du hast gute Excel-Kenntnisse.
  • Du bist technisch aufgeschlossen, arbeitest dich gern in neue Tools ein und interessierst dich für den sinnvollen Einsatz von KI und Automatisierung im Arbeitsalltag.
  • Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Erfahrungen in Kommunikation, Kundenservice, Community Management oder in der Arbeit mit digitalen Produkten gesammelt.

Du musst nicht alle Punkte vollständig erfüllen – wichtig sind uns vor allem ein gutes Gespür für Sprache und Zielgruppe sowie analytisches Denken.


Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Wir bieten eine zukunftssichere Tätigkeit bei einem jungen Unternehmen, das für die 27 Mio. Versicherten der AOK die Umsetzung wirksamer digitaler Dienste (wie z.B. der elektronischen Patientenakte) sicherstellt und dabei nachhaltig die Digitalisierung im Gesundheitswesen vorantreibt.
  • Dazu gibt es eine attraktive Vergütung mit einem Stundenlohn von 18,00 € brutto bei ca. 20 Stunden pro Woche.
  • Wir bieten dir flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten, die sich gut mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen. In Rücksprache mit deinem Team arbeitest du in unserem modernen Büro in zentraler Lage in Berlin oder mobil. Darüber hinaus kommt die ganze Organisation einmal monatlich in Präsenz an unserem Berliner Standort zusammen.
  • Wir bieten flexible Arbeitszeiten, die mit einem Jahresarbeitszeitkonto an deine jeweiligen Bedürfnisse angepasst werden können, sowie ein anteiliger Urlaubsanspruch auf Basis von 30 Urlaubstagen bei einer 5-Tage-Woche.


Du hast noch Fragen?

  • Bei Rückfragen zur Ausschreibung oder dem Bewerbungsprozess stehen wir dir gerne zur Verfügung.
  • Wende dich für Anfragen bitte direkt per Mail an
  • Deine Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben und Lebenslauf) kannst du direkt über den unten stehenden Button "Auf diese Stelle bewerben" über unser Bewerbungsportal einsenden.
  • Alternativ übermittle diese per E-Mail an Datenschutzerklärung zustimmst.


Was du sonst noch wissen solltest

  • Wir stehen für den Inklusionsgedanken. Wir unterstützen daher ausdrücklich Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Schwerbehinderung. Diese werden bei gleicher Eignung und Befähigung bevorzugt berücksichtigt. Unser Unternehmen fördert zudem aktiv die Gleichberechtigung und hat sich zum Ziel gesetzt, die berufliche Entwicklung von Frauen zu unterstützen.

About the Position

HOLY is growing fast: with new product launches, expanding retail partnerships, and an ever-increasing customer base driving demand across all channels.

To keep pace with this momentum, we are looking for a Logistics Manager with a clear focus on Retail and a strong connection to D2C Logistics. You will make sure that retail orders are prepared completely and delivered on time, while also supporting reliable D2C fulfillment, inventory flow, and customer experience.

This role is highly operational and hands-on. You are the kind of person who spots a problem, takes ownership, and fixes it before it becomes a bigger issue.

Retail Logistics Ownership

  • Take end-to-end responsibility for ensuring that retail orders are complete and ready for shipment on time.
  • Own Retail OTIF performance and proactively steer against deviations with fulfillment partners and retail customers.

D2C Logistics Support
  • Support reliable D2C order fulfillment, inventory flow, replenishment, and delivery performance.
  • Monitor open operational issues and coordinate quick resolutions with fulfillment partners, Supply Chain, Customer Service, and E-Commerce.
  • Support accurate system synchronization across warehouses and sales channels.

3PL Partnership & Operations Oversight
  • Act as an operational contact for our fulfillment partners across Retail and D2C topics.
  • Ensure SLA adherence and daily operational stability.
  • Escalate and resolve deviations in speed, accuracy, availability, or cost efficiency swiftly.

Performance Analysis & Reporting
  • Track retail and D2C logistics KPIs and turn them into actionable insights.
  • Use partner reports and internal dashboards to identify risks, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities.

Cross-Functional Coordination
  • Act as the communication bridge between Logistics, Inside Sales, Retail, E-Commerce, Customer Service, Supply Chain, and external partners.
  • Keep stakeholders informed of critical operational updates, risks, and changes.
  • Lead root-cause investigations and coordinate quick resolutions to protect customer experience.
Process Improvement & Scalability
  • Improve recurring logistics workflows across Retail and D2C.
  • Identify efficiency and cost-reduction opportunities and track implementation progress.
  • Help build scalable logistics playbooks for HOLY's omnichannel growth.


About You

  • Retail-Ops-Ownership: You take full end-to-end responsibility for retail order readiness and OTIF performance, proactively steering against deviations before they become escalations.
  • 3PL & partner management: Proven experience managing fulfillment partners operationally - holding them to SLAs, resolving deviations in speed, accuracy or cost quickly and calmly.
  • Cross-functional coordination: Comfortable acting as the bridge between Logistics, Retail, E-Commerce, Customer Service and Supply Chain, keeping stakeholders aligned even when things move fast.
  • Analytical & KPI-driven: Skilled at turning partner reports and internal dashboards into actionable insights, spotting risks and recurring issues early.
  • Language proficiency: Fluency in English and German is a must.


Our Offering

In today's job market, A-players have many options to choose from. As part of our offer, we prioritise providing a productive working environment and opportunities for growth. In addition to competitive compensation, including company shares, you can expect:

  • A successful and growing company: Join a company that has been growing profitable and quickly for the last 36+ months and have just raised a series B, while many other e-commerce companies are struggling.
  • Huge impact: Enjoy huge impact to shape HOLY’s internationalisation in a top market.
  • Awesome team: Join an awesome team of colleagues who are ambitious, funny, down-to-earth, and authentic. Get to know us and see for yourself!
  • Top product: Marketing is important, but a good product is essential. Our differentiated soft drinks have won over customers. Check out our reviews.io reviews or contact us for free samples.
  • Startup culture: Join a startup culture that values flat hierarchies, fast pace, and personal development. With us, you can make a real impact.
  • Perfect setup: Enjoy a perfect setup that includes all the requirements of a modern employer, such as a central office in Berlin Prenzlauerberg, flexible working hours, and much more.
  • Competitive comp. + equity: Join us at a pivotal stage of hypergrowth. We offer a strong salary and meaningful equity—giving you the chance to share in our current success and benefit from the massive upside as we scale.

description_html:
GUARDSPHERE
Saarbrücken, Germany | On-site | Co-Founder / Equity | Deep Tech / OT & Industrial Cybersecurity

About GuardSphere
GuardSphere protects factories, energy plants and critical infrastructure from cyberattacks without ever stopping production. Its product, NeuroX Shield, passively watches a plant's industrial network, learns normal behavior, and lets operators respond to threats safely and gradually — built for mid-sized German manufacturers and utilities who can't afford downtime and have no in-house security specialist.

**The opportunity
**Founded around Farah Elshenawy (7 years in penetration testing, OSCP, MSc Entrepreneurial Cybersecurity at Saarland University/CISPA) and machine-learning lead Nazligul Kese, GuardSphere has validated its prototype with 47+ industry professionals across 6 industrial events and secured €800k in StartupSecure funding. What's missing is the commercial engine to turn validated R&D into revenue. We are looking for a Business / Industry co-founder specialized in OT security go-to-market, GuardSphere is separately also open to a CTO / software co-founder with OT/ICS development experience.

Tasks

What you will own

**Go-to-market & sales
**- Build GuardSphere's route into German manufacturing and utilities, converting strong customer interest (47+ contacts across 6 events) into pilots and paying customers.
- Bridge NeuroX Shield's technical capabilities with the budget and risk-appetite decision cycle of Plant Managers and CISOs.
Commercial strategy
- Understand and navigate industrial procurement processes, budgets and buying decisions in OT/manufacturing.
- Own pricing, packaging and commercial positioning as the prototype becomes a repeatable product.
Company build-up
- Lead incorporation (planned mid-2027) and support fundraising alongside Farah Elshenawy (Project Lead / CEO track).

Requirements

What you bring

**Core experience
**- Business development or sales experience in OT/ICS cybersecurity, industrial automation, or a closely related B2B industrial technology field.
- Understanding of German manufacturing and utilities procurement, budgets and decision cycles.
Especially valuable
- Existing network among Plant Managers, CISOs or OT security buyers.
- Familiarity with IEC 62443 and industrial compliance standards.
- GuardSphere is separately seeking a CTO/Developer co-founder, hands-on OT/ICS software development experience is valuable for that parallel track.

Benefits

Why join GuardSphere
- A prototype already validated through 47+ customer conversations and 6 industrial events, real market pull, not just a hypothesis.
- €800k in non-dilutive StartupSecure funding already secured.
- Ground-floor equity in a company addressing a growing, regulation-driven market (IEC 62443, rising OT/ICS attack surface).

GuardSphere welcomes co-founder candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, sexual identity, or any other characteristic. This is a search for the right partner to build the company with, not a conventional hire.

title: Staff Backend Engineer, Integrations
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Vibe
description_html:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You'll join the Integrations team, the connective tissue of Vibe's platform, reporting to the Engineering Manager. The team owns everything flowing in and out of Vibe: measurement and attribution integrations, audience connections from CRMs and CDPs, and reporting pipelines.

This role exists because we're building a first-class Developer Platform: opening Vibe's full capabilities as a public API so external partners can build on top of us. Criteo is the first partner live on it.

Three reasons to want this:

  • You'll be one of the most senior engineers on Integrations, setting technical direction for a team that's still small enough for one person's decisions to shape it

  • You'll own the foundational architecture for a platform external partners are already building against

  • AI-augmented development is the expectation here, not the experiment

What You'll Do

Build and ship integrations

  • Design and implement production-grade integrations with external platforms: CRMs, CDPs, measurement vendors, data partners

  • Own integration projects end to end, from scoping through production, with full accountability for outcomes

  • Work directly with external partners to define, validate, and evolve data contracts

Developer Platform

  • Drive the architecture of Vibe's public API: account, advertiser, and campaign management endpoints built to scale

  • Build the documentation, monitoring, and tooling that makes the developer experience genuinely good

  • Contribute to the MCP gateway and authentication layers that expose Vibe's capabilities externally

Reliability and scale

  • Find the weak points in existing pipelines and lead the rebuild

  • Set the standard for code quality on the team: your reviews move the bar, not just the diff

  • Use AI tooling to accelerate your own output and raise the team's

Technical leadership

  • Set engineering norms and technical direction as the Integrations team grows

  • Weigh in on architecture decisions across the team, not just your own projects

  • Partner with the Engineering Manager on technical direction and hiring calibration

What You Need

  • 8+ years building production backend systems: APIs, data pipelines, distributed services at scale

  • Strong TypeScript backend experience

  • Direct ownership of a major project, start to finish, not just a contributor role on someone else's

  • AWS and Terraform experience, with real architectural decision-making, not just implementation

  • A high-ownership background: startup, scale-up, or anywhere you couldn't hand the hard problems to someone else

Nice to Haves

  • Third-party integrations experience: ETL, webhooks, REST/GraphQL APIs

  • Python/C++/Rust, alongside your TS work

  • Experience designing or contributing to developer-facing platforms or public APIs

  • Startup experience (~300 people or fewer), current or past. Doesn't need to be your most recent role

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

Location: Paris - the pay range for this role is €88,000–€120,000.

  • Variable pay based on objectives you hit. No arbitrary targets.

  • Hybrid flexibility. We're in the heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week.

  • Health insurance. Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers via Swile.

  • Annual offsite. The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs. Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect: no surprises, no ghosting.

  1. Recruiter screen. 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

  2. Manager Interview. 45 min with your future manager. Your experience, your projects, your approach.

  3. Product Interview. 30 mins with the Product Manager for this team. We want to hear about how you've worked cross-functionally in previous roles.

  4. Technical assessment. 90 min. Code review exercise plus applied questions, including how you use AI in your workflow. Real problems, not tricks.

  5. Bar raiser. 30 min with a senior leader to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar.

  6. Offer. Fast. We don't let good decisions sit.

Equal Opportunity

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Referral Instructions

Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You'll be Vibe's founding security hire. Security has been part of how we build since day one and we're already SOC 2 Type 2 compliant, but nobody has owned it full-time. Ad spend and headcount have both roughly doubled every year since 2022, enterprise partnerships keep expanding, and the more visible Vibe becomes, the more scrutiny comes with it. Now it needs an owner.

You'll define the risk model, set the roadmap, decide what we harden and what we accept, and turn policies into running procedures in code on the paths engineers and AI already use. That work happens in a cloud native ecosystem across AWS and GCP, with most of our services running on Kubernetes, everything as code and a GitOps deployment model.

Reporting to our, Head of Infrastructure, and joining a lean six-person Infrastructure and IT team. You won't do it alone, but you'll be the main contributor, and the person every team turns to on security. Since we joined forces with Walmart, you'll also coordinate directly with their cloud security teams.

What You'll Do

Risk & Governance

  • Map Vibe's risk model across every major system.

  • Set the security roadmap with clear priorities.

Security Engineering

  • Pave the road with guardrails and secure defaults enforced across the engineering tool set.

  • Ship the golden paths so the safe way is the easy one.

  • Harden security across our cloud native ecosystem (AWS and GCP) and third-party providers.

  • Own access management from onboarding to offboarding, and get it to the point where it runs without you.

Detection & Response

  • Prioritize vulnerability findings by real exposure, assign them to the team that owns the code, and follow remediation through to closure.

  • Own security incident response from detection through resolution.

  • Turn manual processes into pipelines that run on their own.

  • Launch and run Vibe's private bug bounty program.

Trust & Compliance

  • Own SOC 2 compliance end to end and maintain current certification.

  • Drive Vibe's future compliance initiatives and requirements.

  • Define Vibe's security posture and make it self-serve so enterprise deals clear security without routing through you.

Security Culture

  • Set clear, practical rules for safe AI use, built into the tools themselves, covering both the AI we ship in our products and the AI our teams work with every day.

  • Run security awareness training and measure behavior changes so the whole company raises its bar.

What You Need

  • Built a security function as a company's first security hire.

  • Write code comfortably and bring deep cloud-native security experience.

  • Managed a compliance framework at scale, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 or HIPAA.

  • Managed AI security risk hands on, both in what a company ships with AI and in how its employees use it day to day.

Nice to Haves

  • Ran a private bug bounty program.
